description: Identical to get_quote: the same price from the same function, plus quoteId and validUntil. Direct rental quote from Galaxy Mind for whole S21 XP rigs (270 TH each), priced per PH per day at today's price and never below our floor. Give rigs (1 to 4 per order) or ph (rounded to whole rigs), and days (1 to 7 during the pilot, default 1). create_rental charges the same number if it is created within 15 minutes. This tool takes no payment and places no order; to rent, call create_rental (see closeTheSale).

days.description: Rental length in whole days, 1 to 7 during the pilot. Defaults to 1.

ph.description: Alternatively, the hashrate wanted in PH/s, up to 1.08. 270 TH minimum; rounded to whole rigs. Overrides rigs.

rigs.description: Number of whole S21 XP rigs (270 TH each), 1 to 4 per order. Defaults to 1.

name: get_rental_quote
